+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""SSL certificate-authentication diagnostics checks for PostgreSQL."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import time
+
+
+IID = "postgres__postgres-commit-0d046a4d7248"
+BIN = Path("/opt/pg/bin")
+DATA = Path("/tmp/acrepair-0d046a4d7248-pgdata")
+WORK = Path("/tmp/acrepair-0d046a4d7248-certs")
+LOG = Path("/tmp/acrepair-0d046a4d7248-postgres.log")
+USER = "aclprobe"
+DATABASE = "template1"
+
+
+def command(args, *, timeout=60, check=True):
+    result = subprocess.run(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                            text=True, timeout=timeout)
+    if check and result.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError("COMMAND_FAILED: " + " ".join(map(str, args)) +
+                           "\n" + result.stdout[-4000:])
+    return result
+
+
+def free_port():
+    with socket.socket() as sock:
+        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        return sock.getsockname()[1]
+
+
+def write_certificate(subject, stem, ca_cert, ca_key):
+    key = WORK / (stem + ".key")
+    csr = WORK / (stem + ".csr")
+    cert = WORK / (stem + ".crt")
+    command(["openssl", "req", "-new", "-newkey", "rsa:2048", "-nodes",
+             "-keyout", str(key), "-out", str(csr), "-subj", subject], timeout=120)
+    command(["openssl", "x509", "-req", "-in", str(csr), "-CA", str(ca_cert),
+             "-CAkey", str(ca_key), "-CAcreateserial", "-out", str(cert),
+             "-days", "1", "-sha256"], timeout=120)
+    key.chmod(0o600)
+    return cert, key
+
+
+def wait_for_tcp(port):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        try:
+            with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=1):
+                return
+        except OSError:
+            time.sleep(0.1)
+    raise RuntimeError("POSTGRES_DID_NOT_LISTEN")
+
+
+def wait_for_log_quiet():
+    previous = LOG.stat().st_size if LOG.exists() else 0
+    stable = 0
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+        current = LOG.stat().st_size if LOG.exists() else 0
+        if current == previous:
+            stable += 1
+            if stable >= 4:
+                return
+        else:
+            previous, stable = current, 0
+    raise RuntimeError("POSTGRES_LOG_DID_NOT_SETTLE")
+
+
+def log_offset():
+    return LOG.stat().st_size if LOG.exists() else 0
+
+
+def log_tail(offset):
+    with LOG.open("rb") as stream:
+        stream.seek(offset)
+        return stream.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+
+def connect(port, cert, key):
+    conninfo = (f"host=127.0.0.1 port={port} dbname={DATABASE} user={USER} "
+                f"sslmode=require sslcert={cert} sslkey={key}")
+    return command([str(BIN / "psql"), "-X", "-d", conninfo, "-c", "SELECT 1;"],
+                   timeout=30, check=False)
+
+
+def main():
+    openssl = shutil.which("openssl")
+    if not openssl:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENSSL_CLI_MISSING")
+    if any(not BIN.joinpath(binary).is_file()
+           for binary in ("initdb", "pg_ctl", "psql")):
+        raise RuntimeError("PINNED_POSTGRES_BINARIES_MISSING")
+    port = free_port()
+    started = False
+    try:
+        WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        ca_key = WORK / "ca.key"
+        ca_cert = WORK / "ca.crt"
+        command([openssl, "req", "-x509", "-newkey", "rsa:2048", "-nodes",
+                 "-keyout", str(ca_key), "-out", str(ca_cert), "-subj",
+                 "/CN=acrepair-test-ca", "-days", "1", "-sha256", "-addext",
+                 "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE"], timeout=120)
+        server_cert, server_key = write_certificate(
+            "/CN=localhost", "server", ca_cert, ca_key)
+        empty_cn_cert, empty_cn_key = write_certificate(
+            "/O=acrepair-no-user", "client-no-cn", ca_cert, ca_key)
+        matching_cert, matching_key = write_certificate(
+            "/CN=" + USER, "client-matching-cn", ca_cert, ca_key)
+
+        if DATA.exists():
+            subprocess.run([str(BIN / "pg_ctl"), "-D", str(DATA), "-m", "immediate", "stop"],
+                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=30)
+            shutil.rmtree(DATA)
+        LOG.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        command([str(BIN / "initdb"), "-D", str(DATA), "-A", "trust"], timeout=300)
+        (DATA / "pg_hba.conf").write_text(
+            "# Local test setup and TCP certificate authentication\n"
+            "local all all trust\n"
+            "hostssl all all 127.0.0.1/32 cert\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        with (DATA / "postgresql.conf").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write("\nssl = on\n")
+            stream.write("ssl_cert_file = '" + str(server_cert) + "'\n")
+            stream.write("ssl_key_file = '" + str(server_key) + "'\n")
+            stream.write("ssl_ca_file = '" + str(ca_cert) + "'\n")
+        command([str(BIN / "pg_ctl"), "-D", str(DATA), "-l", str(LOG),
+                 "-o", "-h 127.0.0.1 -p " + str(port), "start"], timeout=60)
+        started = True
+        wait_for_tcp(port)
+
+        # Local trust is retained for setup; the cert rule applies only to TCP.
+        command([str(BIN / "psql"), "-X", "-h", "/tmp", "-p", str(port), "-U", "postgres",
+                 "-d", DATABASE, "-c", "CREATE USER " + USER + ";"], timeout=30)
+
+        before = log_offset()
+        no_cn = connect(port, empty_cn_cert, empty_cn_key)
+        wait_for_log_quiet()
+        no_cn_log = log_tail(before)
+
+        before = log_offset()
+        matching = connect(port, matching_cert, matching_key)
+        wait_for_log_quiet()
+        matching_log = log_tail(before)
+
+        target_ok = (no_cn.returncode != 0 and
+                     'certificate authentication failed for user "' + USER + '"' in no_cn_log)
+        control_ok = matching.returncode == 0 and "1" in matching.stdout
+        checks = [
+            {"name": "missing_certificate_username_reports_certificate_auth_failure",
+             "kind": "target", "passed": target_ok,
+             "actual": {"returncode": no_cn.returncode, "stdout": no_cn.stdout,
+                        "server_log": no_cn_log},
+             "expected": "no-CN client certificate is rejected with a certificate-authentication diagnostic"},
+            {"name": "matching_certificate_common_name_connects",
+             "kind": "control", "passed": control_ok,
+             "actual": {"returncode": matching.returncode, "stdout": matching.stdout,
+                        "server_log": matching_log},
+             "expected": "CN=aclprobe certificate authenticates and SELECT 1 succeeds"},
+        ]
+        print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+            "instance_id": IID,
+            "checks": checks,
+            "reproduced": not target_ok and control_ok,
+            "scope_note": "The target uses a CA-signed client certificate without a CN; the control uses CN=aclprobe.",
+        }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    finally:
+        if started:
+            subprocess.run([str(BIN / "pg_ctl"), "-D", str(DATA), "-m", "immediate", "stop"],
+                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                           text=True, timeout=30)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Case-specific evaluation entry for postgres__postgres-commit-0d046a4d7248; injected after agent repair."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import runpy
+import sys
+
+INSTANCE_ID = 'postgres__postgres-commit-0d046a4d7248'
+REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS = ['missing_certificate_username_reports_certificate_auth_failure', 'matching_certificate_common_name_connects']
+TEST_STATUS = 'authored_unexecuted'
+EXPECTED_FILES = {'README.md': '9e471664e33a57bca7f9564b5a90538b93ad8d9eaa5b17dce60584d487249b54', 'case_body.py': '0115aabb97defadb7ced6dfc8acb6e64bdcbb0cf7e237b33457aebbedb2e3024', 'record.json': 'f907b37d3087b08eb2e62eedebacad420219cccbd03bf0e2984aa011c55c8881', 'scenario.json': '30e9c4a64050811d9201638333f378ffd34ccf1712a1273e80893d95dcc94d1c', 'scenario.sql': '322b6f351e3411f20720320c7ea99718410b7a761b7f3858739e2ae5d5d5e80f'}
+
+
+def error(reason, **details):
+    print('CHECK_RESULT=' + json.dumps({
+        'instance_id': INSTANCE_ID, 'status': 'BLOCKED' if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder' else 'ERROR',
+        'harness_error': reason, 'required_check_ids': REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS,
+        'checks': [], 'reproduced': False, **details,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    return 2
+
+
+def main():
+    folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    for name, digest in EXPECTED_FILES.items():
+        path = folder / name
+        if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
+            return error('CASE_TEST_ASSET_MISMATCH', asset=name)
+    scenario = json.loads((folder / 'scenario.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+    if scenario.get('instance_id') != INSTANCE_ID:
+        return error('SCENARIO_INSTANCE_MISMATCH')
+    if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder':
+        return error('DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED', blockers=scenario.get('blockers', []),
+                     dependencies=scenario.get('dependency_requirements', []))
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(folder))
+    runpy.run_path(str(folder / 'case_body.py'), run_name='__main__')
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

a uaCert entry in auth_failed().  Put the switch entries into a sane
